Chazz Frichtel is multi-talented songwriter, vocalist, guitarist and bassist. He was born in Prospect, N.Y. and relocated to Los Angeles in the late 70s. He has played bass and toured with a long list of diverse artists including Michael McDonald, Chuck Mangione, Chaka Kahn and Christopher Cross. Chazz sang the theme song for the syndicated television series “Saved by the Bell” and his versatility enabled a rich career in the competitive music business.
Chazz was interviewed in Clinton, NY on June 13, 2016 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. And a fortuitous meeting yesterday leads me to an interview with my old friend Chazz Frichtel. And that was quite an odd thing for us to come together after — I tried to count the years and I gave up.
I know. It’s been a long, long time, but fortuitous, absolutely. It’s great to see you.
